changelog:
Claude Desktop gateway stability fix: adds an internal tool contract / bounded repair loop for explicit tool_choice and readonly file checks without injecting contract notes into user prompts; synthesizes safe readonly file tool_use calls when a concrete file path and read-like tool are available; avoids hard contract errors for broad continuation turns; reduces fake tool-result narration, large-context stream timeouts, preserves image tool results, and avoids concurrent account overload that can trigger 429 retry storms.
Claude Desktop 接入稳定修复版：新增内部 tool contract / 有界 repair loop，用于处理显式 tool_choice 和只读文件检查，且不再把 contract note 注入用户提示；当用户明确检查具体文件且存在 read 类工具时，会安全合成只读 tool_use；普通继续/授权回合不再触发硬 contract 错误；同时缓解伪造 Tool results、大上下文流式超时，修复图片 tool_result 传递，并通过账号 in-flight 跟踪降低并发打爆同一账号导致 429 重试风暴的概率。
